items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: doing that Bessie Smith and the Ma Rainey and all that stuff

ctx.x: I don’t know. Well I think I’ve heard fiction writers talk about this too. I mean I suppose I could have wrestled, I was talking about writing an intro to a song, ‘cause like all that classic blues stuff, doing that Bessie Smith and the Ma Rainey and all that stuff it’s got those little introductions that have almost nothing to do, certainly nothing to do musically with the song. And I really wanted to write one and I couldn’t, and I couldn’t, and I’d written, I’d actually even wrote a song that was very much…
to write about this thing I saw in the newspaper, it’ll be a good song, it’ll sell lots — they’re crap, really.
